test_title: PYST 63: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 23rd December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The news reporter refused to______________ his source of information.
solution:
The correct answer is "**disclose**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option is '**disclose**.'
 
• **Disclose** means *reveal*.
 
• **The correct sentence is: ***The news reporter refused to **disclose** his source of information.*​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us know more about the new reporter.
 
• Reporters provide updates and commentary on current events with the primary objective of keeping the public informed.
